<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market rally:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty surged significantly, driven by a sharp decline in Brent crude prices, positive Q1FY27 earnings, and easing geopolitical tensions in West Asia.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Forex inflows:</strong> RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra reported that recent central bank measures have successfully attracted nearly $32 billion in forex inflows, primarily through FCNR(B) deposits and debt FPIs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Monetary policy outlook:</strong> Economists anticipate the RBI will maintain current interest rates throughout 2026, as growth-related risks are currently viewed as outweighing inflation concerns.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude oil and currency impact:</strong> A 4% drop in Brent crude prices to below $93 has provided a major tailwind for Indian assets, leading to a rally in domestic bonds and a 43-paise appreciation in the rupee.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxNNVhCM3NhdWt2b21jQkl1amZjTkNWVkVETVg0VTNHdHJENVZnNHZqMlZnQUJQaW42UkpDQnNfMGY2OE1tOExIOGRsc3dQd3lrLXZ5d21jVWdkaFRmQVowYl9QTmVEa09OYWJRUjdZMjc3Nm5xZGhESGJDQ1VaSnlPQmhiRThjbmhTLTNxb0dLSVBGY2oySXlIMVc5SHRfUHl4NU9VLUNnN1VsekZRSV80QnlZWXJtUi16UmZNbHdfbHhzWHZ6TVpPT0c0N203UQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
